review_evidence: README identifies Compfiles as a catalog of olympiad-style mathematics problems and solutions formalized in Lean 4.
438 of 548 Lean files contain 5,895 theorem/lemma/example/axiom declarations.

Representative files contain full problem-specific theorem developments and auxiliary lemmas (for example USA 1976 P3 infinite-descent/divisibility lemmas and USA 2017 P6 bounds), making this core formal corpus material.
summary: Reviewed compfiles; retain the large olympiad-problem formalization collection.
